item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - Nine Inch Nails - Pretty Hate Machine (1989 German repress CD)
item.description:
Genre: Industrial rock, industrial dance
Release date: October 20, 1989


I got a german repress, but 3 songs had skips. Some guy eventually uploaded the first pressing, but comparing my cleanly ripped tracks to the tracks he uploaded, mine on average have more dynamic range across the board. I looked at logs online and they reported lower numbers than the ones i had. Today i did a partial reconstruction of the damaged sections of the three tracks. Credit to this guy and posting the original pressing in lossless quality, without him this wouldn't be possible

https://sharemania.us/threads/nine-inch-nails-pretty-hate-machine-1989-original-cd.282563/



Here are the waveforms. The german repress isn't as fat.



My process. Aligning the tracks, and then precisely cutting them, and appropriately lowering the volume so the cuts are seamless



The German repress has a longer transition into Terrible Lie that's cut in the first pressing


These are the changes that i noticed, i wonder if you can find more.
